initialSummary.actualEditorData: T07/T50 were empty despite editor navigation; do not treat as successful content-load verification

observed.cause: The evidence Git Trees mock did not decode nested paths or return paths relative to the requested subtree, so the selected entry blob was not resolved.

correction: Use repository-root paths in fixture data, decode API paths and return direct children relative to the requested tree; require the selected existing article title and body to be visible after a real click.
recheck: Fixed the Git Trees fixture and strengthened T07/T50 assertions; the complete 3-device run passed 150/150 with real title/body values. After a red-frame audit found iPhone T10/T36 lacked annotations, both were authenticated and reshot in a focused run (2/2 PASS); final audit found 145/145 screenshots annotated.
